description: Create an automation: re-run a search on a schedule and send the results somewhere automatically. Pass cities as plain strings (e.g. ['Austin, TX', 'Dallas, TX']) — they're resolved for you. IT SPENDS LEADS ON EVERY RUN, one per result, so confirm the niche, cities and cadence with the user before creating one. A destination of 'close', 'ghl' or 'google_sheets' requires that integration to be connected already (Close also needs one manual export first to save its field mapping); 'csv' | 'xlsx' | 'json' emails a file and needs nothing set up. Every city must resolve and the destination must be one of the listed values, or nothing is created and the error says what to fix. Up to 20 automations, 25 cities each.

destination.description: Where each run's leads go. 'none' just saves them to the library.

keyword.description: The niche to search, e.g. 'roofing contractor'.

spreadsheet_id.description: google_sheets only: add each run to this existing LeadMarina-created sheet, updating rows already in it.

start_at.description: ISO timestamp for the first run. Defaults to now (runs on the next tick, within 15 min).

name: create_automation

destination.description: The destination as saved — what each run will actually use.

title: Schedule a recurring search
